codeReview.summary: The integration-map.md is a thorough, well-structured document that covers all 8 required endpoints with concrete code citations. The worker followed the tui-docs-worker skill procedure correctly: oriented with mission/validation docs, investigated actual codebase via grep/read, authored the doc with path:line citations, and verified with grep + make check-doc-links. All line references were spot-checked and confirmed accurate (agents.go:327, agents.go:426, agents.go:1331, agents.go:1498, agents.go:1522, rooms.go:628, sse/handler.go:11, sse/hub.go:182). One minor off-by-one: rooms.go:294 in the doc vs actual line 295 for RoomsListHandler. All streaming rows (#3, #5, #8) have concrete, non-TBD cancellation and backpressure entries backed by actual code (ConsoleAskRuntime channel caps default to 16, SSE hub Client.Send cap is 64, hub drops on full).

issues.description: Minor line reference off-by-one: row 7 cites 'api/rooms.go:294 (RoomsListHandler)' but the actual function definition is at line 295. All other line references checked are accurate.

Row 3 (ask-stream) describes the adapter as 'ConsoleAskRuntime + SSE subscription via /api/events topic filter' but the Key Methods column lists Enqueue() and Updates() which belong to ConsoleAskRuntime only — the SSE subscription methods are described elsewhere in the doc but not in this cell. This is minor since the SSE subscription is covered in row 5.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The integration-map doc reveals important backpressure semantics that are not captured in .factory/library/architecture.md or any other shared state doc: (1) ConsoleAskRuntime and ConsoleCancelRuntime both use bounded channels with default cap 16, blocking on full; (2) SSE hub Client.Send channel has cap 64 with silent drop on full; (3) Hub.broadcast channel has cap 256 with drop on full. These concrete buffer sizes and drop/block policies are critical for M2/M3 implementation decisions and would benefit engineers working on the TUI adapter layer.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: integration-map.md rows 3-5 describe these in detail. console_ask_runtime.go:11-12 confirms defaultConsoleAskRequestBufferSize=16, defaultConsoleAskUpdateBufferSize=16. sse/handler.go:50 confirms Send channel cap 64. hub.go:71 confirms broadcast cap 256.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The doc identifies 4 proposed adapter structs (EventsSubscriber, RoomAdapter, RoomEventsSubscriber, AgentRuntimeAdapter) that are not yet in the codebase but are needed for M2/M3. The .factory/library/architecture.md does not enumerate these proposed structs. Capturing this planned inventory would help M2/M3 workers know what they need to build.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: integration-map.md 'Adapter Inventory — Current vs Proposed' table lists 6 current and 4 proposed structs. architecture.md's component descriptions don't enumerate these specific adapter names.
